en.groupPlaceholder: Trip to Da Lat, apartment, etc.

en.receiptTooLarge: This group can store up to {{limit}} MB of receipt data.
en.openingDataHelp: Existing groups stay on this device.
en.storageUnavailable: Offline storage could not be opened

en.nearbyLinkInvalid: This nearby pairing link is invalid or expired.
en.syncBackupHelp: Transfer {{groupName}} to a nearby device, or create an encrypted file for backup and recovery.
en.encryptedOnDevice: Protect this file with a passphrase

en.mergeNotOverwriteBody: If this group already exists here, matching records are merged. A different group is added. Changes to the same field stop for manual resolution, so neither version is overwritten.
en.encryptedSyncCreatedBody: Move {{filename}} to the other device, then choose Import there.
en.syncCreateFailed: The sync file could not be created.
en.enterPassphraseBody: Use the passphrase chosen when the file was exported.
en.importFailedBody: The file could not be imported. Check the file and passphrase, then try again.
en.syncNearbyHelp: Transfer {{groupName}} directly over the same Wi-Fi. Cloudflare only coordinates the connection, group data stays peer-to-peer.
en.nearbyUnsupported: Nearby sync may not work in this browser
en.nearbyUnsupportedBody: This browser is missing {{requirements}}. Use encrypted Export and Import below to move or back up this group.
en.qrTitle: Scan to receive this Going Dutch transfer
en.nearbyCodeHelpLong: On the receiving device, scan this QR code or enter the six-digit code. It expires after 60 seconds.
en.cloudQrTitle: Scan to join this temporary encrypted Going Dutch cloud transfer
en.cloudRelayHelp: Keep both devices open. The cloud relays encrypted data and does not store your group.
en.joinCloudTransferHelp: Keep both browsers open. Cloudflare relays encrypted frames and does not store your group.
en.joiningCode: Receiving transfer {{code}}. Keep both browsers open while the direct connection is made.
